# Support

Ways to get help with `@inandu-solutions/grid-core`:

- **Questions and usage help** — [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-core/discussions)
- **Bug reports and feature requests** — [open an issue](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-core/issues/new/choose)
- **The grids that use it** — [`inandu-grid`](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid) (Angular), [`inandu-grid-react`](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-react) and [`inandu-grid-vue`](https://github.com/inandusolutions/inandu-grid-vue)
- **Security reports** — see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); please don't open a public issue

For commercial support and the `@inandu-solutions/grid-pro` add-ons, see <https://www.inandu.com>.
